description: Conjugate Gradient sparse iterative solver from the NAS Parallel Benchmarks. Performs SpMV in CSR format, dot products, and AXPY vector operations to solve Ax = b.

scaling_param.name: matrix_size
scaling_param.description: Number of rows/columns in the sparse matrix

non_scaling_params.name: max_cg_iterations
non_scaling_params.description: Maximum number of CG iterations per solve

non_scaling_params.name: nonzeros_per_row
non_scaling_params.description: Average number of nonzero entries per row in the sparse matrix

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
